title: Plant Head And Operations Manager
description:
Role & responsibilities Overall Plant Operations: Manage complete factory operations, including Production, Quality, Maintenance, Stores, Packing, and Dispatch. Production Planning: Ensure daily, weekly, and monthly production targets are achieved as per customer requirements. Manpower Management: Effectively manage manpower, labour productivity, shift planning, discipline, and workforce utilization. Quality Control: Ensure zero-defect production, implement quality standards, and minimize customer complaints and rejections. Cost Control: Reduce manufacturing costs, material wastage, scrap, downtime, and unnecessary expenses. Machine & Maintenance: Ensure maximum machine utilization, preventive maintenance, and minimum breakdowns. Process Improvement: Implement Lean Manufacturing, 5S, Kaizen, and continuous improvement activities. Inventory Management: Coordinate with Stores and Purchase teams to maintain optimum raw material and finished goods inventory. Dispatch Management: Ensure 100% on-time delivery as per customer schedules and commitments. MIS & Reporting: Prepare daily production, rejection, efficiency, manpower, and dispatch reports for management. Team Leadership: Lead Production, Quality, Maintenance, and Store teams with clear accountability and performance monitoring. Customer Compliance: Ensure manufacturing processes meet OEM customer quality standards and audit requirements. Required Skills & Experience: Experience in Sheet Metal Manufacturing, Press Shop, Fabrication, and Powder Coating. Strong knowledge of Production Planning, Quality Management, and Cost Reduction. Experience handling OEM customers and high-volume manufacturing. Strong leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Ability to independently manage complete factory operations. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs): 100% Production Target Achievement 100% On-Time Dispatch Minimum Rejection & Customer Complaints Maximum Machine & Manpower Productivity Continuous Manufacturing Cost Reduction Minimum Machine Downtime 



 Perks and benefits 
 Competitive Salary Package Performance-Based Salary Increments Annual Performance Bonus (Based on Company Policy) Career Growth & Promotion Opportunities Job Stability & Long-Term Career Opportunities Paid Leaves as per Company Policy Professional & Supportive Work Environment Opportunity to Work with Leading OEM Brands Leadership & Decision-Making Opportunities
